description: Inverses: what undoes each operation of a batch. Applying `operations` to `base` with inverses on gives `inverse`, one list per operation. Applying those lists last first, each in a call of its own with `restoring` set, gives back `base`. Ids a delete names and the entries an add lists compare as sets keyed by id; numbers compare by value. Each case names the rule it checks in `rule`; README.md lists the rules. The expected outputs are reviewed data that every engine must meet.
